description: Angular component for user management in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, user activation, and notification handling.

classes.name: UserComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent for user-related UI functionalities, including form management and user actions.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if the delete option should be hidden based on table config.

methods.name: isUserCredentialsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if user credentials are enabled for the current user entity.

methods.name: isUserActivated
methods.description: Checks if the user is activated.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs a reactive form group for user data input.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with data from a User entity.

methods.name: onUserIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches a notification when the user ID is copied.
